mejoras.detalle: New Front Wing A completely new front wing design, aimed at improved flow conditioning towards the floor and bodywork resulting in improved aerodynamic performance. 2 Rear Wing Performance – Local Load New Rear Wing Assembly A new rear wing assembly has been designed for this event, aiming to increase aerodynamic load efficiently in all conditions.
New Beam Wing In conjunction with the aforementioned rear wing, a new beam wing has been designed for improved interaction and flow conditioning.
Updated Floor Furniture A small modification to the floor furniture, resulting in better flow conditioning and resultant improvement of aerodynamic performance of the floor.
